name: cleanplate
alternateName: 开源自托管视频去水印与自动质检管线
description: Open-source, self-hosted asynchronous video watermark detection, multi-ROI diffusion inpainting, and automated QA pipeline node built on FastAPI, ComfyUI v0.45.0, OpenCV, and FFmpeg. Automatically detects static, semi-transparent, or moving watermarks and subtitles without manual bounding boxes, plans 16px-aligned ROI crops and 81-frame (4k+1) chunks with clean-chunk GPU bypass, executes a MiniMax-Remover -> DiffuEraser fallback chain, preserves lossless audio and SDR bt709 color metadata, runs post-inpaint QA gates, and delivers clean outputs plus structured JSON reports via OpenAPI REST polling or HMAC-SHA256 webhooks.
operatingSystem: Linux / macOS (NVIDIA CUDA GPU 16-24 GB+ VRAM required for production AI inference)
applicationSubCategory: Automated video watermark detection, subtitle/overlay erasure, and video inpainting API service
featureList: FFmpeg CFR ingest normalization for VFR, rotated, odd-dimension, or non-yuv420p clips with SDR bt709/smpte170m color-tag preservation

Single-pass automatic watermark detection combining CPU OpenCV static/persistent-edge voting and VRAM-bounded ComfyUI native SAM 3.1 tracking (<=180 strided frames at <=960p, 3-frame RAM temporal streaming)
Per-watermark 16px-aligned multi-ROI crop chaining (expand_roi_chain) and 81-frame (4k+1) chunk planning with zero-inference clean-chunk GPU bypass (bypassed_chunks) on watermark-free windows
Multi-model inpainting fallback chain (MiniMax-Remover 1.3B -> ComfyUI-native ModelPatcher DiffuEraser + ProPainter) plus CPU local_fallback for pipeline smoke verification
Container-aware lossless audio stream copy (-c:a copy), demux -t audio clamping preventing tail-frame truncation, SDR setparams color preservation, and +faststart MP4 assembly
Automated post-inpaint QA gate checking mask_mean_abs_diff (INPAINT_NO_EFFECT failover) and static residual_overlap (needs_review / QA_RESIDUAL_WATERMARK)

Agent-ready FastAPI OpenAPI 3.1 queue (/openapi.json) with SHA-256 X-API-Key auth, Idempotency-Key serialization, per-tenant 429 Retry-After rate limits, stage-progress worker watchdog, isolated ComfyUI spool with /interrupt orphan cleanup, loopback proxy bypass, and CGNAT/IPv6-hardened HMAC-SHA256 webhooks

CLI suite for SHA-256 verified Hugging Face & GitHub Release weight installation, commercial license auditing (cleanplate-worker --doctor), retention cleanup, clean-plate PSNR/SSIM/flicker evaluation, and live model scouting (cleanplate-scout)
softwareRequirements: NVIDIA CUDA GPU (~16-24 GB+ VRAM) and ComfyUI v0.45.0 for real AI video inpainting
